name: Southern Infoconsultants Limited
about: Southern Infoconsultants Limited, a software company, engages in the provision of information technology (IT) and IT-related services in India. It also provides IT hardware/software, and IT support services. The company was formerly known as Southern Infosys Limited and changed its name to Southern Infoconsultants Limited in May 2025. Southern Infoconsultants Limited was incorporated in 1994 and is based in New Delhi, India.
